messages:
alex: Heads up — Orion Cloud requested we credit a portion of Q3 reserved GPUs back to marketplace pool if they ship delayed. They want a pro rata credit and a swap permission for nearby DCs. Anyone on allocation details?

marta: I'm on it. Do we have contract clause for partial-crediting? I thought only full cancellations.

kenji: Contract allows pro rata credits for >30d delay. Need SOC to approve ledger entry. pinging @samir for finance impact.

samir: Finance: pro rata is fine if partner confirms ETD >30d and we adjust committed capacity. Need a signed amendment. Estimated P&L impact: ~$110k over Q3 if applied to 200 GPUs.

jia: Ops: if warehouse swap required we can swap to SFO->ORD route, but that adds 7–10 days. Can we ask partner for expedited manifest?

orion_partner: Orion logistics here — confirmed a hold at EU port, ETD now 28 days out. We can push expedited for subset (50 units) but need marketplace re-route approval.

alex: @orion_partner thanks. We need formal eta note + new manifest. For the crediting workflow, @marta can you draft a 1-paragraph amendment? We'll use our marketplace reserve-credit template.

marta: Drafted, attaching snippet:

```
If shipment ETD exceeds 30 days from original delivery date, Redwood may elect pro rata credit against Reserved Capacity fees equal to (delayed_units / reserved_units) * monthly_commit_fee for affected months.
```

marta: sending to legal now. cc @kenji

kenji: Temp workaround: we can float capacity from other partners in NA to cover high-priority Dedicated customers. Need product approval for routing change. @alex do we have a list of affected customers?

alex: short list — acme, sailo, fintech-prod. I'll DM product for priority mapping.

cloudops-bot: [autosched] Swap request queued: swap-req-8923 requires human approval.

samir: If we approve pro rata credit, recommend we apply to next invoice cycle and issue a Marketplace credit memo. Ops should mark those GPUs as "pending-credit" in the allocation ledger.

jia: I'll label physical inventory and update route. If partner pushes expedited 50 units, we can re-assign to Dedicated pool for acme.

orion_partner: Sending manifest + expedited PO now, ETA updates in 10m.

alex: thanks. Action items: @marta amendment, @legal sign-off, @samir credit memo plan, @jia ops swap, @kenji product routing approval. We'll reconvene if manifest arrives. :thumbsup: 

marta: on it.

kenji: started product approval flow.

samir: prepping credit memo template.

jia: holding swap window until confirm manifest.
